subject: CS471
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. The English coverage is comprehensive, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. For Arabic, two topics, 'Virus Structure' and 'Worm Propagation Models', had no relevant candidates in the computer security context; all available videos were either medical or in unrelated academic fields. The selected Arabic videos are strong, direct matches for their respective topics.

coverage.note: No relevant candidates found; all Arabic videos on 'virus' were medical in nature and failed the relevance gate.
No candidates found on computer worm propagation models. Available videos on 'models' were for AI, economics, or other fields, failing the relevance gate.
